errors.text_span: На графиката са представени две линии: червена и синя.
errors.evidence: The chart displays a single data series, represented by one red line with blue circular markers. The description incorrectly identifies the markers as a separate blue line.

errors.text_span: Синята линия също започва през 2003 г. приблизително на 35,5%, като през следващите години показва сходни тенденции с червената линия. През 2009 г. също достига връх, а през 2023 г. завършва на малко над 32%.
errors.evidence: This entire paragraph describes a non-existent second 'blue line'. The chart only has one red line, and the blue elements are markers on that line, not a separate data series.

errors.text_span: През посочените години двете линии си приличат, като на определени етапи са почти еднакви.
errors.evidence: This sentence compares the real red line with the hallucinated blue line. Since there is only one line, this comparison is invalid.
The description states that the value in 2006 drops below 36%. However, the data point for 2006 is visibly above the 36.0 grid line, at approximately 36.4%.

The description fails to mention that the single data series is plotted with a solid line and has blue circular markers at each data point. This information was explicitly requested in the prompt but was omitted due to the misinterpretation of the markers as a second line.
